lines: Flirtatious Man
Dammit! I won't let you forget this!
The pick-up artists, having had their weapons knocked down, their faces slammed into the sandy beach, and their will to fight stripped away,
had run off with a far-too-uninspiring line, tripping over the sand as they went.
Me
SheeshーYou okay?
I called out to the woman who had been surrounded.
Aina
I coulda handled guys like that myself, y'know...
Aina
But, well, thanks anyway.
The woman gave a small thanks, seeming uncomfortable as she did.
Aina
I'm Aina, Aina Winchester.
Me
I'm Fuma. So you're pretty strong, Aina. I'm surprised...
Aina wasn't bluffing when she said she could take care of them on her own.
In fact, she had been the one to beat up most of them.
Me
If you're that strong, why'd you let them walk all over you before?
Aina
I ain't used to that kinda thing, so... my body wouldn't move. So I'm glad'ya were here.
Aina
So, why've ya been looking over there for a while now?
She was right. I had been talking to Aina with my gaze turned toward the sea for some time.
Me
(I can't help it!)
I shot a quick glance toward Aina as I shouted within my mind.
With that tiny swimsuit plastered on, it looked like she was going to spill out of it at any second. I was having quite the time trying to figure out where to look...
Me
You can't expect me to look you in the eye with something that small on. And I shouldn't really say this, but it's no wonder you got mixed up with those pickup creeps...
Aina
Wha-!? It's not like I'm wearin' this 'cause I wanna!
Me
Huh? So you're not a guest at this resort?
Aina
That's...
Aina
It's kinda hard to talk about here. Let's go over there.
With a serious look on her face, Aina urged me toward an area with no people around.
Me
Perhaps there was some reason for it. Well, I was in the same boat.
In any case, being here had made me anxious about the gazes of people around us.
We walked down to the corner of the beach.
